improve.title: Defensive work rate
tips: When we lose it, press for 3-5 seconds right away. That's when they're most disorganized.
Know your runner before the cross comes in. A quick look over the shoulder saves a goal.
Defend the space, not just the player. Stand in the lane they want to pass into.
improve.coach: 67% historically, 40% now. You're winning this one.

improve.title: On-ball involvement
tips: Drift into the half-space between their midfield and defense. It's the hardest spot to mark.
Check away, then check back. A two-yard feint buys you the space to receive.
Give the passer an angle - diagonal to the ball, not flat in a line where it can't reach you.
improve.coach: Shows up 33% of the time. Steady means it's a habit.

improve.title: Off-ball positioning
tips: Goal-side and central first, ball-side second. Cover the space behind the full-back when they press.
Hold the line with your partner and step up together. Don't let a dropping striker drag you out.
Your rating came in lower than your stats say, and that gap is off-ball: positioning, interceptions, blocks.
improve.coach: Down to 20% from 33%. Stay on it.

strengths.title: Goal threat
strengths.coach: That's the sound of the scoreboard saying thank you. There 44% of the time. Reliable as rain.

strengths.title: Chance creation
strengths.coach: You were the playmaker, the matchmaker and the good-time maker. 44% and counting. Keep it up.
